name: Corporate Housing & MTR
intro: Reservations, guest services and property coordinators who keep bookings, guests and turnovers moving through every season.

roleDetails.text: Handles booking inquiries, manages the reservations calendar and keeps availability and rates accurate across channels.
Answers guest and resident messages, handles requests and issues during the stay, and keeps reviews in good shape.
Works leads from inquiry to signed lease: answers questions, schedules showings and gets the paperwork done.
Tracks the units in your portfolio, coordinates maintenance and vendors, and keeps owner and property records up to date.
Schedules cleaning, inspections and repairs between stays so each unit is ready on time for the next guest.
Watches occupancy, demand and competitor rates, and adjusts pricing to keep units booked at the right rate.
